critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is used inside create_contact exception handler (line 86) but defined only at line 121 - during module import order it's still fine because request handlers run later, but stylistically the logger config block should be above route definitions.
TechStack.jsx uses colored letter-mark tiles instead of real vendor logos - acceptable per component comment for network reliability, but a nice-to-have would be actual SVG icons.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ prefixed contact leads inserted during backend + frontend E2E tests; no cleanup needed for a marketing app.
